audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Darius / Darius / Skill / Darius / Skill / Darius / Darius, which disagrees with the already-audited mirror page (audits/top/gwen__darius.json) and with this entry's own late text.
audit.why: Mirror ruling: Darius owns 1-3 outright, 4-5 through first item is even once Hallowed Mist and Needlework are online, and two-plus items is Gwen because his stacked HP feeds %-max-HP Snip Snip! and A Thousand Cuts. Ratings stay inverse of the Gwen page.
audit.corrected: Darius / Darius / Darius / Skill / Skill / Skill / Gwen in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Stage texts give no cooldowns, and Level 6 carries the LaTeX fragment 'R = d + a \times Stacks'.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s and Skip 'n Slash 13s with a partial refund on hit — those two numbers are the entire timing of the lane and neither appears.
audit.corrected: Mist and Skip 'n Slash cooldowns named; Level 6 text rewritten in plain language.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places tell you to 'pull her out of Hallowed Mist with E Apprehend', and Level 6 says Noxian Guillotine 'ignores' the mist. wants.foe[2] and content.late also credit her mobility to 'R Needlework dashes' and 'R resets'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Hallowed Mist: she can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist. Apprehend from outside does not reach her and neither does the Guillotine — you have to walk in, which is exactly what the entry's own tldr says. And Needlework is three thrown needles with a slow; her dash is Skip 'n Slash (E), 13s at rank 1 and partly refunded when it hits.
audit.corrected: Step into the mist to pull and to execute; Skip 'n Slash named as her mobility.

audit.why: A Thousand Cuts heals her off a portion of the bonus magic damage she deals to champions, so the extended trade she wants pays her health back. Grievous Wounds timing decides the lane after her first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text writes her Q as 'Snip Snip' without the exclamation mark, flagged by the packet's suspectNames.
breakdown.carry says 'Carry threat: 7.5/10' while carryRating and the report both say 8.5/10.

edits.before: Full basic kits unlocked on both sides; spacing out displacements determines the winner. Keep the wave near your tower so Gwen has to walk into pull range.
edits.after: Gwen has no mist yet, so Apprehend into the Decimate outer blade lands clean. Keep the wave near your tower so Gwen has to walk into pull range.

edits.before: Optimal lane control window for Darius to establish strict minion freezes. Track Hallowed Mist before you commit the pull.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist evens it: from outside you cannot touch her. Walk into the mist to commit, or wait out its 22-second cooldown.

edits.before: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage R = d + a \times Stacks, bypassing defensive items completely. The execute resets on takedowns — all-in windows are now real kill windows.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine is true damage scaled by Hemorrhage stacks, but it cannot target her inside the mist. Step in first — then the execute resets on every takedown.

edits.before: Stridebreaker fixes your stickiness — the run-down you couldn't finish before is now lethal. Force fights on Hallowed Mist's cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker fixes your stickiness, but Skip 'n Slash refunds itself on hit. Commit inside her mist while it is down, not on her terms.

edits.before: You stay a side-lane terror but fall off vs grouped teams. Look for flank pulls in fights; one reset chain can win the game.
edits.after: Every point of HP you stack feeds Snip Snip! and A Thousand Cuts. Flank for pulls in fog; one reset chain can still win games.

edits.before: Carry threat: 7.5/10. If Gwen gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and playing with your jungler.
edits.after: Carry threat: 8.5/10. If Gwen gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and playing with your jungler.

edits.before: Before Gwen has items her W Hallowed Mist is her only escape, so pull her out of it with E Apprehend or wait it out and W Crippling Strike her the moment she steps clear. Land outer-Q for the heal and stack Hemorrhage — her early trades are weak and she can't sustain a five-stack bleed.
edits.after: Before Gwen has items W Hallowed Mist is her only escape, and you cannot touch her from outside it — walk into the mist to fight or wait its 22-second cooldown and W Crippling Strike her the moment she steps clear. Land outer-Q for the heal and stack Hemorrhage; she can't survive a five-stack bleed.

edits.before: R Noxian Guillotine ignores the fact that her W mist blocks your autos and single-target abilities — but you have to catch her outside it. Force her to burn W early with an E-pull, then execute at max stacks before Snip Snip! true damage lets her scale out of your kill range.
edits.after: R Noxian Guillotine cannot target her inside Hallowed Mist either — you have to be standing in it, or she has to be out. Force her to burn W early, step in after her, then execute at max stacks before Snip Snip! true damage lets her scale out of your kill range.

edits.before: E Apprehend pulls her out of W, giving you the tempo at 3.
edits.after: At 3 she has no mist yet, so your Apprehend all-in lands clean.

edits.before: W slow plus outer-Q heal beats her thin early sustain at 4-5.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist arrives at 4-5 and blanks you from outside it.

edits.before: Your first-item all-in still out-trades her pre-Riftmaker melee kit.
edits.after: First item is even: Skip 'n Slash refunds itself whenever it hits.

edits.before: Kite all-ins with R Needlework dashes
edits.after: Kite all-ins with Skip 'n Slash refunds

edits.before: You keep control through 6: E Apprehend drags her out of Hallowed Mist, W slows the follow-up, and your bleed outpaces her early Q sustain. Force her to waste W defensively, then ult at five stacks before her true-damage scaling arrives.
edits.after: You keep control through 6, but Hallowed Mist sets the rule: from outside it you cannot pull or execute her, so step inside to commit. W slows the follow-up and your bleed beats her sustain. Force the mist, walk in, and ult at five stacks.

edits.before: After Nashor's/Riftmaker Gwen wins: Snip Snip! true damage ignores your armor, W blocks your combo on demand, and R resets let her dance out of every all-in. Stop dueling her in the open — group and only fight her when her W is down.
edits.after: After Nashor's/Riftmaker Gwen wins: Snip Snip! true damage ignores armor, W blanks you unless you stand in it, and Skip 'n Slash refunds on hit. Buy Grievous Wounds — A Thousand Cuts heals her off you. Only fight her when her W is down.

notes: Chart matched to the already-audited mirror at audits/top/gwen__darius.json (Darius/Darius/Darius/Skill/Skill/Skill/Gwen). Hallowed Mist untargetability is the decisive interaction and the content layer had it backwards in three places while the full-layer tldr had it right.
